name: Choksi Asia Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, Choksi Imaging Ltd manufactures and trades X-ray films that find application in medical imaging. In addition, it is engaged in the trading of various items used in the healthcare industry.
keyPoints:
Product Portfolio:[1]
a) Ultrasound and Color Doppler[2]
b) X-Ray Films & Chemicals[3]
c) X-Ray Accessories[4]
d) NDT[5]

pros: Debtor days have improved from 115 to 82.2 days.
Promoter holding has increased by 8.92% over last quarter.
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 877 days to 138 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 5.96% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.63 Cr.
